notes:
Beta 1.5.16 - bulletproof server badges via per-read getChat hook.

Fix: badges now survive every code path. DialogCell + ProfileActivity call MessagesController.getChat(Long) / getChatFull(long) on each bind; a new GetChatBadgeHook re-applies the server badge on every read (fast-path: skip when the badge cache is empty). Combined with the existing getUser hook coverage and the proactive update-batch patcher, the badge stays put in the chat list, channel header, own profile, and other people's profiles.
